errors.text_span: während der Balken für Frankreich in einem dunkleren, violett-grauen Farbton gehalten ist
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the bar for France (Frankreich) is dark purple-grey. The bar for EU27 is dark purple, while the bar for France is blue.
The description fails to mention that the OECD bar is also visually highlighted with a distinct color (a light purple/magenta).
